newsitem.title: USA: Vanstar sees soft third quarter earnings.
newsitem.headline: Vanstar sees soft third quarter earnings.

text.p: Vanstar Corp said Thursday it expects third quarter earnings to fall below analysts' estimates.

It said based on current projections, it expects third quarter revenues of $540-$555 million, net income of $6.5-$7.5 million, and earnings per share of $0.15-$0.17, including charges related to acquisitions.
Vanstar did not specify the analysts' estimates it was referring to.
The company, which has scheduled a teleconference at 0900 EST/1400 GMT, cited product shortages and lower demand in November.

It said January performance, including an almost record product shipment pace, could not offset the November weakness. It also said holiday season scheduling by customers meant lower-than-expected revenues at its Professional Services business.
